description:
Tekka Centre in Singapore’s Little India has long been associated with good budget South Asian food. Cafe chef Rathakrishnan helps us discover the variety of regional cuisines at the heritage hawker centre.  

The highlight is the Michelin Bib Gourmand-awarded Delhi Lahori, where owner Naseer Ahmed Khan has combined the tastes of India and Pakistan together in set meals that cost just S$6 (US$4.60). 

WATCH MORE Lunch With Us: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkMf14VQEvTb6pxNMx7n5Ogn_wPC--sDo

0:00 Teaser and origins of Tekka Centre 
1:01 South Indian bites at Sri Tiffan Stall 
1:34 Sri Lankan food: Mango curry, banana flower masala
3:20 Affordable pricing at Delhi Lahori  
4:08 Why combine Indian and Pakistani cuisine?  
5:12 Trying tandoor-baked garlic naan and keema (minced mutton curry) 
7:00 Making 1,000 naan a day in charcoal tandoor
